title: Middle layer super output areas, December 2021 (England and Wales, generalised, clipped)
description: Census 2021 middle layer super output areas for England and Wales, the tier between lower layer super output areas and local authority districts.

files.note: Exported from the Open Geography Portal feature service "Middle_layer_Super_Output_Areas_December_2021_Boundaries_EW_BGC_V3" (https://services1.arcgis.com/ESMARspQHYMw9BZ9/arcgis/rest/services/Middle_layer_Super_Output_Areas_December_2021_Boundaries_EW_BGC_V3/FeatureServer/0/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=geojson), 7,264 features in WGS84. The portal serves this product through the API rather than as a named download, so the file is named for the layer and reproduced by rerunning that query rather than by filename. 6,856 English and 408 Welsh areas.
